definitions.short: Timna , the name of two Edomites
definitions.full: H8555. Timna תִּמְנָע proper name, masculine and feminine Edomite name. ᵐ5 θαμνα : — 1 תִּמְנָע proper name, masculine a. a chief of Edom Gen 36:40 = 1Chr 1:51 . b. son of Eliphaz 1Chr 1:36 (for Korah Gen 36:15-16 ,). 2 תִּמְנָע֑ feminine Gen 36:22 = 1Chr 1:39 sister of Lotan (of Seir); Gen 3:12 concubine of Eliphaz son of Esau. מַנְעוּל , [ מִנְעָל ] see נעל . [ מַנְעַמִּים ] see נעם . מְנַָֽעַנְעִים see נוע . [ מְנַקִּית ], מְנַקִּיָּה see נקה מֵנֶ֫קֶת see ינק Hiph`il מְנֹרָה see מְנוֺרָה below נור .

occurrences.englishText: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.
The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
